sloka: सा वस्त्रमङ्गरागं च भूषणानि स्रजस्तथा ।मैथिली प्रतिजग्राह प्रीतिदानमनुत्तमम् ॥ २.११८.२१॥
transliteration: sā vastramaṅgarāgaṁ ca bhūṣaṇāni srajastathā ।maithilī pratijagrāha prītidānamanuttamam ॥ 2.118.21॥

translations.english: That princess from Mithila accepted the incomparable gifts of love, the raiment, fragrant unguents, jewellery and also the garland.
